# Empowered DLD

> Evidence-based resources, books, and community for families and professionals supporting people with Developmental Language Disorder (DLD).

Empowered DLD is an advocacy and education platform raising awareness of Developmental Language Disorder, a lifelong neurodevelopmental condition that affects how a person learns, understands, and uses spoken language. We publish research-informed guides, picture books, professional training, and downloadable tools for parents, speech-language pathologists (SLPs), educators, and organizations.

DLD is one of the most common developmental conditions affecting roughly 1 in 14 people (Norbury et al., 2016) yet remains widely under-recognized. Our mission is to change that with plain-language explainers, screening guidance, classroom and clinic resources, and a growing library of curriculum-aligned books.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.empowereddld.com/): Overview of Empowered DLD's mission, books, and resources for the DLD community.
- [About DLD](https://www.empowereddld.com/about-dld): What Developmental Language Disorder is, how common it is, signs to look for, and why it matters across the lifespan.
- [Who We Serve](https://www.empowereddld.com/who-we-serve): Pathways for parents, therapists, educators, and organizations.
- [For Parents](https://www.empowereddld.com/for-parents): Family-focused guidance, advocacy tools, and home strategies.
- [For Therapists](https://www.empowereddld.com/for-therapists): Clinical resources, IEP support, and professional development for SLPs.
- [For Educators](https://www.empowereddld.com/for-educators): Classroom strategies, accommodations, and DLD awareness materials for teachers.
- [For Organizations](https://www.empowereddld.com/for-organizations): Partnership packages, bulk orders, and implementation support for schools, clinics, and districts.

## Resources

- [Resource library](https://www.empowereddld.com/resources): Hub for blog posts, free course, podcasts, and downloadable tools.
- [Blog](https://www.empowereddld.com/resources/blog): Long-form articles on DLD identification, intervention, advocacy, and research.
- [Free DLD course](https://www.empowereddld.com/resources/free-course): Self-paced introduction to Developmental Language Disorder.
- [Podcasts](https://www.empowereddld.com/resources/podcasts): Conversations with researchers, clinicians, and families.
- [Downloadable tools](https://www.empowereddld.com/resources/downloadables): Checklists, handouts, and worksheets.
- [Language Impact Checklist](https://www.empowereddld.com/resources/language-impact-checklist): Screening tool to help families and educators flag possible language concerns.
